purpose: Offline HVAC insulation takeoff pricing: measurements + specs + price book -> priced quote.

entry_points.python: from local_estimator import estimate, load_measurements, load_specs

public.name: InsulationSpec
public.summary: One insulation rule from the project spec (Division 23 07 xx), e.g. 'CHW pipe 0.5-2 in -> 1 in elastomeric'.

public.name: MaterialItem
public.summary: A priced (or flagged-unpriced) material line.

public.name: MeasurementItem
public.summary: One takeoff line: a run of duct or pipe (from Bluebeam, a CSV, or typed by hand).

public.name: ProjectQuote
public.summary: ProjectQuote(project_name: 'str', quote_number: 'str', date: 'str', measurements: 'List[MeasurementItem]', materials: 'List[MaterialItem]', labor_hours: 'float', labor_rate: 'float', subtotal: 'float', contingency_percent: 'float', total: 'float', notes: 'List[str]', material_list: 'List[Dict[str, Any]]')

public.name: ParsedSize
public.summary: ParsedSize(kind, dims)

public.name: classify_location
public.summary: Free-text location -> 'outdoor' | 'indoor'. Used to match a run to an indoor/outdoor spec.

public.name: parse_length_ft
public.summary: Bluebeam/CSV length -> feet. Accepts 125.5, '125.5', '1,250 ft', "125' 6\"", '18 in'. Raises ValueError otherwise.

public.name: parse_size
public.summary: '18x12' -> rect(18,12); '4"' / '4 inch' / '1-1/2"' -> round; unparseable -> None (never a silent default).

public.name: surface_area_sf
public.summary: Outside surface area of an insulated run.

public.name: PriceBook
public.summary: Immutable-ish lookup table. Build with ``PriceBook.load(path)`` or ``PriceBook(dict)``.

modules.role: Company exclusions (what we do not bid)

public.name: apply_scope
public.signature: apply_scope(specs: 'List[InsulationSpec]', measurements: 'List[MeasurementItem]', keywords: 'List[str]' = ['duct liner', 'liner', 'internal liner', 'acoustic liner', 'acoustic only', 'waste', 'sanitary', 'domestic water', 'plumbing', 'drain', 'sewer', 'fire sprinkler', 'sprinkler', 'fire protection pipe', 'underground', 'buried', 'below grade']) -> 'Tuple[List[InsulationSpec], List[MeasurementItem], List[Dict[str, str]]]'
public.summary: Return (kept specs, kept measurements, exclusions[{kind,id,reason}]).

public.name: measurement_exclusion_reason
public.signature: measurement_exclusion_reason(m: 'MeasurementItem', keywords: 'List[str]' = ['duct liner', 'liner', 'internal liner', 'acoustic liner', 'acoustic only', 'waste', 'sanitary', 'domestic water', 'plumbing', 'drain', 'sewer', 'fire sprinkler', 'sprinkler', 'fire protection pipe', 'underground', 'buried', 'below grade']) -> 'Optional[str]'

public.name: spec_exclusion_reason
public.signature: spec_exclusion_reason(spec: 'InsulationSpec', keywords: 'List[str]' = ['duct liner', 'liner', 'internal liner', 'acoustic liner', 'acoustic only', 'waste', 'sanitary', 'domestic water', 'plumbing', 'drain', 'sewer', 'fire sprinkler', 'sprinkler', 'fire protection pipe', 'underground', 'buried', 'below grade']) -> 'Optional[str]'

public.name: load_measurements
public.summary: CSV or JSON file -> (measurements, load warnings).

public.name: load_specs
public.summary: Spec table (CSV or JSON). Columns: system_type,size_range,thickness,material[,facing,special_requirements,location]. special_requirements in CSV is a ';'-separated list.

modules.role: Pipeline entry point estimate(), quote assembly, alternatives

public.name: EstimateResult
public.summary: EstimateResult(quote: 'ProjectQuote', alternatives: 'Dict[str, Dict[str, float]]' = <factory>, warnings: 'List[str]' = <factory>, exclusions: 'List[Dict[str, str]]' = <factory>)

public.name: consolidate_materials
public.summary: Merge identical lines (same description+unit) into a distributor-ready list sorted by category.

public.name: estimate
public.signature: estimate(project_name: 'str', measurements: 'List[MeasurementItem]', specs: 'List[InsulationSpec]', *, pricebook: 'Optional[PriceBook]' = None, markup_percent: 'float' = 0.0, labor_rate: 'float' = 65.0, contingency_percent: 'float' = 10.0, fitting_allowance_lf: 'Optional[Dict[str, float]]' = None, apply_scope_filter: 'bool' = True, include_alternatives: 'bool' = True, extra_warnings: 'Optional[List[str]]' = None, quote_number: 'Optional[str]' = None, quote_date: 'Optional[str]' = None) -> 'EstimateResult'
public.summary: Price a takeoff. ``markup_percent`` applies to material prices only (15 -> x1.15).

public.name: upgrade_alternatives
public.summary: Price two common upgrades. An alternative is omitted if it cannot be fully priced from the price book.

public.name: render_bundle
public.summary: One text document: docs, manifest, source, data, tests. Paste into a chat with an AI that cannot read your files.
